meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会安装 OneCLI 并配置 Agent Vault 网关,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 凭据迁移进 vault,迁移后从 .env 删除这些凭据行;若 .env 没有凭据,则走注册新凭据的流程,最后重新构建并重启服务验证。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 这个破坏性变更之后,或首次从头配置 OneCLI 时触发。若 package.json 里没有 @onecli-sh/sdk,它会先让你跑 /update-nanoclaw。

say.note: 会安装 CLI 与网关并把 .env 凭据迁入 vault

say.text: 把 .env 里的 Anthropic 凭据迁移到 OneCLI
say.note: 迁移成功后从 .env 删除这些行

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,从头装一遍
say.note: 会重装并重新注册凭据

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, and migrates credentials from .env into the vault, removing those lines from .env. If .env has none, it registers credentials fresh, then rebuilds and restarts the service to verify.
howto.when_en: Runs after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for a first-time OneCLI setup. If @onecli-sh/sdk is missing from package.json, it tells you to run /update-nanoclaw first.

say_en.note: Installs the CLI and gateway, migrates .env credentials

say_en.text: Migrate my Anthropic credentials from .env to OneCLI
say_en.note: Removes those lines from .env after migrating
